claims.statement: Native's products are clean and free from parabens, sulfates, and animal testing.
claims.quote: For us, it’s personal. ## Clean No parabens. No sulfates. No animal testing. No gray area. Our ingredients come from nature, are barely processed, and are 100% vegan.

claims.statement: Native's products are known for their delightful and irresistible scents.
claims.quote: Craveable Self-care should feel delightful. Our award-winning formulas are known for their irresistible scents. Don’t be surprised if you want to sniff them all day and crave them later.

claims.statement: Native's products are dermatologist-tested and designed to deliver multiple benefits.
claims.quote: Effective Our dermatologist-tested products are designed to deliver benefits you want and your body needs. Moisturizing, cleansing, scrubbing, protecting — we do it all (and then some).
